chunks_partition.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (xs : List α), (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).1.flatten ++ (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).2 = xs ∧ (∀ c ∈ (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).1, c.length = n) ∧ (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).2.length < n

chunks_exact.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (s : Slice α) (n : Usize), 0 < n.val → core.slice.Slice.chunks_exact s n ⦃ fun it => (it.chunks.map Slice.val).flatten ++ it.remainder.val = s.val ∧ (∀ c ∈ it.chunks, c.val.length = n.val) ∧ it.remainder.val.length < n.val ⦄

inner_step.statement: ∀ (bytes : Slice U8) (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem : Slice U8) (a b : algo.U32X4) (hlen : 4 ≤ bytes.val.length) (ha : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → a.val[i]!.val + bytes.val[i]!.val ≤ U32.max) (hb : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → b.val[i]!.val + (a.val[i]!.val + bytes.val[i]!.val) ≤ U32.max), algo.Adler32.compute_loop0_loop0.body { chunks := bytes :: cs, remainder := rem } a b ⦃ fun r => ∃ av bv, r = .cont ({ chunks := cs, remainder := rem }, av, bv) ∧ (∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → av.val[i]!.val = a.val[i]!.val + bytes.val[i]!.val) ∧ (∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → bv.val[i]!.val = b.val[i]!.val + (a.val[i]!.val + bytes.val[i]!.val)) ⦄

inner_loop_bounded.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem : Slice U8) (a b : algo.U32X4) (hchunks : ∀ c ∈ cs, 4 ≤ c.val.length) (hlen : cs.length ≤ 5552) (ha : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → a.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) (hb : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → b.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520), algo.Adler32.compute_loop0_loop0 { chunks := cs, remainder := rem } a b ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → (out.1.val[i]!.val, out.2.val[i]!.val) = AdlerProof.laneRun cs a.val[i]!.val b.val[i]!.val i ⦄

remainder_inner_loop_bounded.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem : Slice U8) (a b : algo.U32X4) (hchunks : ∀ c ∈ cs, 4 ≤ c.val.length) (hlen : cs.length ≤ 5552) (ha : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → a.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520) (hb : ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → b.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520), algo.Adler32.compute_loop1 { chunks := cs, remainder := rem } a b ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → (out.1.val[i]!.val, out.2.val[i]!.val) = AdlerProof.laneRun cs a.val[i]!.val b.val[i]!.val i ⦄

chunk_count_bound.statement: ∀ (cs : List (Slice U8)) (rem source : Slice U8) (hpartition : (cs.map Slice.val).flatten ++ rem.val = source.val) (hfull : ∀ c ∈ cs, c.val.length = 4) (hlen : source.val.length ≤ 22208), cs.length ≤ 5552

lane_rem.statement: ∀ (self : algo.U32X4) (q : U32), 0 < q.val → algo.U32X4.Insts.CoreOpsArithRemAssignU32.rem_assign self q ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → out.val[i]!.val = self.val[i]!.val % q.val ⦄

lane_normalize.statement: ∀ (self : algo.U32X4), algo.U32X4.Insts.CoreOpsArithRemAssignU32.rem_assign self algo.Adler32.compute.MOD ⦃ fun out => ∀ i : Nat, i < 4 → out.val[i]!.val = self.val[i]!.val % 65521 ∧ out.val[i]!.val ≤ 65520 ⦄
